h1.en: Power and particle size for the Electric 40 Concrete Pump stay on the printed row
h1.zh: 电动40型混凝土泵的动力和粒径以已印行为准

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Electric 40 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-40-concrete-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model Electric 40; Motor Power 45 kW; Output Capacity 21 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m; Aggregate 13 Pumping (H / V) 40 m / 120 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112; Dimensions (L×W×H) 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; Main Unit Weight 2300 kg. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and Main Unit Weight is 2300 kg. The printed output cell is 21 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m; Aggregate 13 Pumping (H / V) 40 m / 120 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 45 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/electric-40-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground-penetrating_radar. It shows: Ground penetrating radar in use near Stillwater, Oklahoma, US in 2010. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动40型混凝土泵列在 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 Electric 40; 电机功率 45 kW; 理论输送量 21 m³/h; 最大出口压力 23 MPa; 料斗容积 0.4 m³; 细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m; 13 骨料输送（水平/垂直） 40 m / 120 m; 液压泵 Kawasaki 112; 外形尺寸 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; 整机重量 2300 kg。运输请抄外形尺寸是 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm，整机重量是 2300 kg。已印输送量是 21 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；13 骨料输送（水平/垂直） 40 m / 120 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 45 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。这一页没有印最大骨料或粒径。仍然把粒径发给邢台，问这一已列配件或机器是否接受。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground-penetrating_radar 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：2010年在俄克拉荷马使用探地雷达的现场。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

body.en: Put /products/electric-40-concrete-pump in the subject. The published cells are: Model Electric 40; Motor Power 45 kW; Output Capacity 21 m³/h; Max. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump。已公布的格子是：型号 Electric 40; 电机功率 45 kW; 理论输送量 21 m³/h; 最大出口压力 23 MPa; 料斗容积 0.4 m³; 细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m; 13 骨料输送（水平/垂直） 40 m / 120 m; 液压泵 Kawasaki 112; 外形尺寸 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; 整机重量 2300 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: The printed output cell is 21 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m; Aggregate 13 Pumping (H / V) 40 m / 120 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 45 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it.
body.zh: 已印输送量是 21 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；13 骨料输送（水平/垂直） 40 m / 120 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 45 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。这一页没有印最大骨料或粒径。仍然把粒径发给邢台，问这一已列配件或机器是否接受。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/electric-40-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

answer.en: No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。
